entries.16dbcbefb7ea60c3: A semiconductor-related manufacturer based in Amagasaki, Hyogo Prefecture, whose main product is probe cards, components for semiconductor testing, and which also makes electron tube components.
entries.1ed7cb9939691cd6: This is a probe card that uses probe units based on MEMS (micro electro mechanical systems) technology. The company offers the MC, ML and MT series.
entries.344ae1f80a401e2d: This is the main business, developing, manufacturing and selling components for semiconductor testing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥29,142 million, accounting for almost all consolidated revenue. The company and seven overseas consolidated subsidiaries are responsible for it, producing at the Kumamoto Office, the head office, the Mita Plant, and the subsidiary plants in Taiwan, Shanghai, the United States and Thailand. Its main customers are semiconductor manufacturers.
entries.4688d24fac0db47e: Manufacturers that use cathodes and filaments
entries.50f6a964e6c7bd94: This business is the company's cathodes and filaments for electron tube components. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥223 million, and sales are made within Japan. Production is outsourced.
entries.c3274e0b7136603f: This is a probe card with vertical probes, mainly used for higher integration and higher speed of semiconductors. It includes the VT series, which uses vertical contact; the VS series, which uses vertical spring contact; and the VE series, which combines vertical and cantilever probes.
entries.c58f5268f813778d: Cathodes used in electron tubes. This product has been offered since the company began manufacturing and selling cathodes for cathode ray tubes at its founding.
entries.db13a3dde8d791af: This is a probe card whose probe (needle) has a cantilever structure. The company offers the CE series.
